---
title: "Microbiome: Heatmap figure"
output: html_document

Heatmap showing relative changes in microbial taxa that changed significantly when comparing HMP-Full and UC. The color scale reflects relative abundance changes pre- and post-intervention (brown = increase, green = decrease). Black indicates that the ASV did not significanty change when compared. Annotation bars on the left indicate whether each taxon is classified as a short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) producer (per Frolova et al., 2022). The file SCFA_ref.csv contains the information from Frolova et al., 2022. 
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)
library(MicrobiomeStat)
library(pheatmap) 
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
})
```
    
```{r}

subject_var <- "ppt_id"
timepoint_var <- "time"


sample_df <- sample_data(ps.27may) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  as_tibble()


valid_subjects <- sample_df |> 
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var), !!sym(timepoint_var)) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(n == 1) |> 
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var)) |> 
  summarise(n_timepoints = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(n_timepoints == 2) |> 
  pull(!!sym(subject_var))


filtered_sample_ids <- sample_df %>%
  filter(!!sym(subject_var) %in% valid_subjects) %>%
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var)) |> 
  pull(BW_ID) |> 
    as.character()  


ps_filtered <- prune_samples(filtered_sample_ids, ps.27may)
```

```{r}
 ps_full_out <- subset_samples(ps_filtered, !sr_scr_rand_group == "hmp_active")
```


```{r}
prev.filter  <- 0.01  
abund.filter <- 0.001 
winsor_q     <- 0.97   
subject.var  <- "ppt_id"
time.var     <- "time"
change.base  <- "1"
group.var    <- "sr_scr_rand_group"

# -----------------------------
# TSS normalization
# -----------------------------
ps_tss <- transform_sample_counts(
 ps_full_out,
  function(x) x / ifelse(sum(x) > 0, sum(x), 1)
)

# Ensure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_tss)) {
  otu_table(ps_tss) <- otu_table(t(otu_table(ps_tss)), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
}

# -----------------------------
# Extract data
# -----------------------------
OTU_raw <- as(otu_table(ps_tss), "matrix")   # taxa x samples
md      <- as(sample_data(ps_tss), "data.frame")

# -----------------------------
# FILTERING (on RAW TSS)
# -----------------------------
keep_taxa <- rowMeans(OTU_raw > 0, na.rm = TRUE) >= prev.filter &
  (if (is.infinite(abund.filter) && abund.filter < 0) TRUE 
   else rowMeans(OTU_raw, na.rm = TRUE) >= abund.filter)

OTU <- OTU_raw[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# ZERO IMPUTATION (after filtering)
# -----------------------------
impute_half_min_per_sample <- function(M, tiny = 0) {
  half_min <- apply(M, 2, function(x) {
    m <- suppressWarnings(min(x[x > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (!is.finite(m)) tiny else m / 2
  })
  repl <- matrix(half_min, nrow = nrow(M), ncol = ncol(M), byrow = TRUE)
  zero_mat <- (M == 0) & !is.na(M)
  M[zero_mat] <- repl[zero_mat]
  M
}

OTU_imp <- impute_half_min_per_sample(OTU, tiny = 0)

# -----------------------------
# Winsorization
# -----------------------------
winsorize_cols <- function(M, w = 0.97) {
  lo_p <- (1 - w) / 2
  hi_p <- 1 - lo_p
  
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(M))) {
    xj <- M[, j]
    qs <- quantile(xj, probs = c(lo_p, hi_p), na.rm = TRUE)
    xj[xj < qs[1]] <- qs[1]
    xj[xj > qs[2]] <- qs[2]
    M[, j] <- xj
  }
  M
}



# -----------------------------
# Rebuild phyloseq
# -----------------------------
ps_proc <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(OTU_imp, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  sample_data(ps_tss),
  tax_table(ps_tss)[rownames(OTU_imp), , drop = FALSE]
)

# -----------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# -----------------------------
sample_data(ps_proc)[[time.var]] <- forcats::fct_relevel(
  as.factor(sample_data(ps_proc)[[time.var]]),
  change.base
)

md  <- as(sample_data(ps_proc), "data.frame")
OTU <- as(otu_table(ps_proc), "matrix")

# -----------------------------
# LONG FORMAT
# -----------------------------
df_long <- as.data.frame(OTU) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::left_join(md |> tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample"), by = "Sample") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[time.var]])) |>
  dplyr::mutate(.time = stringr::str_trim(as.character(.data[[time.var]])))

# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------
valid_subjects <- df_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data[[subject.var]], .time) |>
  dplyr::count(.data[[subject.var]]) |>
  dplyr::filter(n == 2) |>
  dplyr::pull(!!rlang::sym(subject.var))

df_long <- df_long |>
  dplyr::filter(.data[[subject.var]] %in% valid_subjects)

# -----------------------------
# WIDE FORMAT (paired)
# -----------------------------
wide <- df_long |>
  dplyr::select(feature, value, !!sym(subject.var), !!sym(group.var), .time) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .time, names_prefix = "T_", values_from = value)

time_cols <- setdiff(colnames(wide), c("feature", subject.var, group.var))
stopifnot(length(time_cols) == 2)

base_col  <- paste0("T_", change.base)
stopifnot(base_col %in% time_cols)

other_col <- setdiff(time_cols, base_col)[1]

# -----------------------------
# COMPUTE RELATIVE CHANGE PER SUBJECT
# -----------------------------
relative_change_df <- wide |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    denom = .data[[other_col]] + .data[[base_col]],
    change_rel_ms = dplyr::if_else(
      denom == 0,
      0,
      (.data[[other_col]] - .data[[base_col]]) / denom
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# GROUP-LEVEL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------
relative_change_df_UCFull <- relative_change_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(feature, !!rlang::sym(group.var)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_change = mean(change_rel_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = !!sym(group.var),
    values_from = mean_change
  )
```

md  <- as(sample_data(ps_proc), "data.frame")
OTU <- as(otu_table(ps_proc), "matrix")

# -----------------------------

df_long <- as.data.frame(OTU) |>

```{r}
features_of_interest <-sig_taxa |> 
                      pull(ASV)


relative_change.1 <-relative_change_df_UCFull |> 
  filter (feature %in%features_of_interest_full )

relative_change.2 <-relative_change_df_UCActive |> 
  filter (feature %in%features_of_interest_full )

relative_change_fulldf <- relative_change.1|> 
            left_join(relative_change.2, by= "feature")


features_of_interest_full <-sig_taxa |> 
                       filter (group=="UCvFull") |> 
                      pull(ASV)

relative_change_full_df1 <-relative_change_fulldf |> 
  filter (feature %in%features_of_interest_full )

```
```{r}

tax <- tax_table(ps.27may)
tax_with_asv <- cbind(ASV = rownames(tax), tax)
tax_table(ps.27may) <- tax_table(tax_with_asv)

tax_with_asv_df <- as.data.frame(tax_with_asv)

SCFA_taxa<-tax_with_asv_df |> 
  mutate(genus_species = str_c(Genus, Species, sep = " ")) |> 
  left_join(scfa_list ) |> 
  mutate(across(c(Butyrate, Propionate, Acetate, Formate), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

```{r}


heat_df.1 <-relative_change_full_df1 |>
  rename(ASV = feature) |>
  left_join(SCFA_taxa, by = "ASV") |>
  unite("taxa",Family,Genus, Species, ASV,sep = " ") |> 
  unique()


heat_mat <- heat_df.1 |> 
   dplyr::select(taxa, hmp_full, hmp_active, uc.x) |> 
  column_to_rownames(var="taxa") |> 
  as.matrix() 

row_annotation <- heat_df.1 |> 
  select(taxa, Butyrate, Propionate, Acetate, Formate) |> 
  mutate(across(c(Butyrate, Propionate, Acetate, Formate), as.character)) |> 
  column_to_rownames("taxa")


scfa_colors <- list(
  Butyrate    = c("1" = "#FFFACD", "0" = "grey90"),
  Propionate  = c("1" = "#FFFACD", "0" = "grey90"),
  Acetate     = c("1" = "#FFFACD", "0" = "grey90"),
  Formate     = c("1" = "#FFFACD", "0" = "grey90")
)

col_annotation <- data.frame(
  Treatment = c("uc", "hmp_active","hmp_full")
)
row.names(col_annotation) <- colnames(heat_mat)

col_colors <- list(
  Treatment = c(
    hmp_active = "#DF8F44",
      hmp_full   = "#374E55",
      uc         = "#00A1D5"
  )
)

pheatmap(
heat_mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 7,
  cellheight = 7,
  border_color = NA,
   colorRampPalette(c("#137665","#81beb4" ,"#dfd8d2","#846a77", "#3d222f"))(1000),
na_col = "black",
  annotation_col = col_annotation,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_colors = c(col_colors, scfa_colors)
)
```
